opus.problem: Naming Delilah, together with shaving his braids, gives the word away on its own, so the clue is not medium hard. Also, 'Nazirite' is not in Judges 16:19 (it comes from 16:17 or 13:5).
'Blind and mocked' is not in the cited Judges 16:29-30. His blinding is in 16:21 and the mocking in 16:25, so the reference does not support the clue as written.
'After his wife was given away' is not in the cited Judges 15:4-5. It comes from 15:2, so the reference does not cover the whole clue.
The cited Judges 14:12-14 names thirty garments, not thirty Philistine guests. The thirty companions and the wedding feast are in 14:10-11, so the reference does not cover the whole clue.
